source: The reviewer's reading of round10_20261112/families.json, before any owner read. Concerns were raised on the first version (c75a8e757), or, where the record says so, on the author's second version (9a495c763), which changed 12 families' texts. Three families were then revised in round10_20261112_rev1.
not_exhaustive: Source-fit concerns are recorded where the speaker or population clearly differs from the family's and the expression is distinctive. Plain vocabulary taken from case reports and reviews was not flagged per family; the source-check file states that limit for the batch.
